title: The pizza counter
story:
The pizzeria is opening a counter where players buy food with coins. The menu has three items: a Slice for 10 coins, a Soda for 4, and Garlic bread for 6. Players press a button on their screen, the request travels to the server, and the server decides.

Exploiters will try everything, so the server checks every request and never errors on a bad one. The checker tests your Shop with a stand-in player, and reads your server and client scripts to check they're wired up.
create: A ModuleScript `Shop` and a Script `ShopServer`, the server side.
Assume a RemoteFunction named `Buy` in `ReplicatedStorage.Course.Test12`, and a TextButton named `BuySlice` inside a ScreenGui named `Test12`.

requirements.text: `Shop.setup(player)` gives the player a Folder named `leaderstats` holding an IntValue named `Coins`, starting at 50.
`Shop.buy(player, item)` sells a `"Slice"` (10), `"Soda"` (4) or `"Garlic"` (6): it takes the coins and returns `true` and the coins left.
For anything that isn't one of those exact item names, including wrong types like numbers, tables and `nil`, `buy` returns `false, "unknown item"` without erroring or changing the coins.
When the player can't afford the item, `buy` returns `false, "not enough coins"` and changes nothing. Having exactly enough is fine.
`Shop.setup(player)` creates the leaderstats. Calling it again for the same player changes nothing.
`ShopServer` sets the `Buy` RemoteFunction's `OnServerInvoke`, so requests go to `Shop.buy`.
`ShopServer` sets up players who join later (with `PlayerAdded`) and players already in the game when it starts (with `GetPlayers`).
`ShopClient` connects the `BuySlice` button's `Activated` event, and asks the server to buy a Slice with `InvokeServer` on the `Buy` remote.

hints: Keep the menu in a dictionary from item name to price inside Shop. Looking an item up in it answers "is this a real item?" for every type at once, since only exact string keys match.

setup should check for an existing leaderstats folder before making one. ShopServer connects PlayerAdded and loops over the current players, then assigns a function to Buy.OnServerInvoke that calls Shop.buy.
In ShopClient, wait for the PlayerGui, the Test12 ScreenGui and the button, then connect Activated to a function that invokes the remote with the item name.

static.fail: Create a ModuleScript named `Shop` in the `Test12` folder.
Create a Script named `ShopServer` in the `Test12` folder.
ShopServer should assign a function to Buy.OnServerInvoke.
ShopServer should also set up players already in the game, using GetPlayers.
ShopClient should connect to the button's Activated event.
ShopClient should call InvokeServer on the Buy remote.

check:
local Shop, loadInfo = Course.load("ServerScriptService.Course.Test12.Shop")
if type(Shop) ~= "table" or type(Shop.buy) ~= "function" or type(Shop.setup) ~= "function" then
	for _, id in { "r2", "r3", "r4", "r5", "r6" } do
		Course.fail(id, "Shop should return a table with setup and buy functions, but " .. (loadInfo.error or ("it returned " .. Course.show(Shop))))
	end
	return
end
local player = Instance.new("Player")
player.Name = "Tester"
local setupOk, setupProblem = Course.call(Shop.setup, player)
local stats = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
local coins = stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Coins")
Course.check("r2", setupOk and coins ~= nil and coins:IsA("IntValue") and coins.Value == 50,
	"Shop.setup(player) should give the player a Folder named leaderstats holding an IntValue named Coins set to 50. " ..
	(if not setupOk then "It errored: " .. tostring(setupProblem) elseif coins then "Coins is a " .. coins.ClassName .. " with value " .. tostring(coins.Value) else "No leaderstats.Coins appeared."))
if not coins then
	for _, id in { "r3", "r4", "r5", "r6" } do
		Course.fail(id, "Not checked: setup didn't create leaderstats.Coins.")
	end
	return
end

local function buy(item)
	local good, ok, value = Course.call(Shop.buy, player, item)
	if not good then
		return "error", ok
	end
	return ok, value
end

coins.Value = 50
local ok1, left1 = buy("Slice")
Course.check("r3", ok1 == true and left1 == 40 and coins.Value == 40, "With 50 coins, buy(player, \"Slice\") should return true, 40 and leave Coins at 40, but returned " .. Course.show({ ok1, left1 }) .. " with Coins at " .. coins.Value)
local ok2, left2 = buy("Garlic")
Course.check("r3", ok2 == true and left2 == 34 and coins.Value == 34, "Then buying \"Garlic\" (6 coins) should return true, 34, but returned " .. Course.show({ ok2, left2 }))

for _, item in { "Pizza", "slice", 5, {}, true } do
	local before = coins.Value
	local result, reason = buy(item)
	if result == "error" then
		Course.fail("r4", "buy(player, " .. Course.show(item) .. ") errored on the server: " .. tostring(reason) .. ". Bad requests should return false and a reason instead.")
	else
		Course.check("r4", result == false and reason == "unknown item" and coins.Value == before, "buy(player, " .. Course.show(item) .. ") should return false, \"unknown item\" and not change the coins, but returned " .. Course.show({ result, reason }))
	end
end
local nilResult, nilReason = buy(nil)
Course.check("r4", nilResult == false and nilReason == "unknown item", "buy(player, nil) should return false, \"unknown item\" without erroring, but returned " .. Course.show({ nilResult, nilReason }))

coins.Value = 3
local ok3, reason3 = buy("Soda")
Course.check("r5", ok3 == false and reason3 == "not enough coins" and coins.Value == 3, "With 3 coins, buying a Soda (4 coins) should return false, \"not enough coins\" and leave the coins alone, but returned " .. Course.show({ ok3, reason3 }) .. " with Coins at " .. coins.Value)
coins.Value = 4
local ok4, left4 = buy("Soda")
Course.check("r5", ok4 == true and left4 == 0 and coins.Value == 0, "With exactly 4 coins, buying a Soda should work and leave 0, but returned " .. Course.show({ ok4, left4 }))

coins.Value = 17
local good = Course.call(Shop.setup, player)
local folders = 0
for _, child in player:GetChildren() do
	if child.Name == "leaderstats" then
		folders += 1
	end
end
Course.check("r6", good and folders == 1 and coins.Parent and coins.Value == 17, "Calling setup again for a player who's already set up should change nothing: one leaderstats folder, and their coins kept. Found " .. folders .. " leaderstats folders and Coins at " .. coins.Value)
steps: **Shop tab (ModuleScript):** keep the prices Slice 10, Soda 4 and Garlic 6 in a table.
`Shop.setup(player)`: put a Folder named `leaderstats` inside the player, holding an IntValue named `Coins` with a Value of 50. If the player already has leaderstats, do nothing.

`Shop.buy(player, item)`: if the item is on the menu and the player has enough coins, take the price away and return `true` and the coins left. For anything not exactly on the menu, including `nil`, numbers, tables and `"slice"`, return `false, "unknown item"`. When they can't afford it, return `false, "not enough coins"`. Never error.

**ShopServer tab (Script):** require Shop. Call setup for every player who joins, and for players already in the game. Set `OnServerInvoke` on the Buy RemoteFunction to a function that calls Shop.buy.
**ShopClient tab (LocalScript):** find the BuySlice button in the player's PlayerGui. When it's `Activated`, call `InvokeServer("Slice")` on the Buy remote.
example:
A new player has 50 coins.
buy(player, "Slice") gives true, 40
buy(player, "Pizza") gives false, "unknown item"
With 3 coins, buy(player, "Soda") gives false, "not enough coins"
